summary: Firefox expanded web-platform support and reliability, including speculation-rules prefetching, Declarative Web Push, and WebCrypto support for ML-KEM, a post-quantum key-establishment standard. It also completed parts of CSS Typed OM for transforms and perspective, updated the naming of Feature Policy to Permissions Policy, and refined SpeechRecognition behavior for cross-origin audio. Separately, page lifecycle and navigation changes improve telemetry for background loads, release canvas resources sooner, and make scrolling, image sizing, and browser security checks more consistent.
